Help
Help (F1)
What each part of this screen does
Folder and storage
Shows the folder the temporary files are written to and the storage device it is on.
Picks another folder, for example on a memory card, to fill that storage device instead. Not available while filling runs.
Free space
How much space the storage device has free right now. Filling writes temporary files into this space, except for the part kept free.

The slider sets how much space stays free for the system and other apps while filling runs. The usual amount is the last stop of the slider. A smaller amount fills more but leaves less room, and it applies to the next run only. Hidden while filling runs.

Asks for confirmation, then fills the free space above the part kept free. Available when a folder is chosen, its free space is measured and larger than the part kept free, and no files of an earlier run wait to be deleted.
Confirmation

Before filling, a question shows how much will be written, to which folder and storage, and how much stays free. If you lowered the space kept free, an extra paragraph says so, because the system and other apps then have less room while the run lasts. Fill starts; Cancel changes nothing.
Progress
While filling runs: how much is written of the planned amount, the share done and the time left.
Keep the app open
While filling runs, asks you to keep the app open. When the app closes, the fill stops and the files stay on the storage; open the app again to fill the rest or to delete them.
Stops filling at once and deletes every temporary file this run wrote. Your own files are not touched.

Fills the rest of a fill that stopped when the app closed: it writes to the same folder and storage, then deletes every temporary file as always. Offered next to Delete remaining files while the leftover files are on a connected storage.

Appears when the files of a fill that did not finish are still on a storage device, for example after the storage was disconnected or the app closed. Connect that storage, then tap it: only the files the app wrote are deleted. Filling waits until they are gone.
Result
After a run, says how it ended: done, stopped, or what went wrong and what to do next.
Watch screen

The same app runs on a Wear OS watch, on a screen of its own. The watch screen has no help button; this explanation is its help too. Its About button shows the running version and the author, and names the phone app. The watch writes temporary files to the watch storage only, with no folder choice. Filling runs in the background with a notification, and the notification\'s Stop button stops filling and deletes the files.
Opens this explanation. Close it with Back, a tap outside the list, Esc or F1.
Color theme
Switches between Auto (follow device), Light, Dark, and six custom accent colour themes.
